reason: The cited evidence directly supports all key premises: E1 and E2 confirm the synthesis of HCP RuRhPdPtIr layers via heteroepitaxy on Ru seeds, the enhanced alkaline HER activity versus FCC, the role of synergistic electronic interactions, thermal stability up to 500 °C, and the 6.4-fold improvement in alkaline media. The premises are accurately represented without overstatement.
premises: Heteroepitaxial deposition on HCP Ru seeds forces an unconventional HCP structure in RuRhPdPtIr HEA layers
HCP RuRhPdPtIr HEA layers exhibit improved alkaline HER activity compared to FCC counterparts
The improvement is due to synergistic electronic interactions that tune H* and OH* binding energies
The HCP structure is stable under synthesis conditions (<200 °C) and up to 500 °C
The effect is specific to alkaline media, with a larger improvement (6.4x) than in acid (1.6x)
